items.message: Max Endurance in the Survival panel should now show your whole endurance pool

Rebirth and Thunderspy: Fulcrum Shift and Kinetic Transfer now add their damage bonus, and the slider counts the enemies you hit, up to 20 over two casts. Rebirth's Siphon Power and Fulcrum Flip add theirs too.
Soul Absorption now adds its Regeneration and Recovery bonus for each enemy it hits

Attacks now show their chance to hit in the Info panel, beside Accuracy. It follows the Target level and Level shift in Build Settings and counts your To Hit buffs, so setting Target level to +4 shows how often the power lands against +4 enemies
The top bar now shows the level your next power pick goes in. On phones it is in the bar with the Pwr and Slot counts

With UI scale above or below 100%, an enhancement's hover card should no longer runs off the bottom or side of the window, a power's ⋮ menu opens under its button again, and the top bar's menus no longer open too far to the side
An enhancement's hover card that is taller than your window now shows its set pieces and set bonuses beside the rest, so the whole card fits on screen
Strength of Will and other powers whose recharge can't be boosted now show their real recharge on the power card.

Homecoming, Brainstorm and Thunderspy: Prismatic Shield, Force Field Generator, Triage Beacon, Faraday Cage and Spirit Tree now count the enhancements slotted in them when their buff is switched on in your totals. Before, they always added their unenhanced amount
HC database updated to Issue 28: Legacy, Page 4.
Defense and Resistance are now split on separate rows, so a set like Fiery Aura no longer hides its low Cold resistance behind its Fire.
Each power now has a pin button next to its ⋮ menu. One click locks the Info panel on that power, and a second click unlocks it

Swap Ammo's ammo types, Staff Fighting's Forms and Bio Armor's Adaptations can be chosen right on the power, and the choice changes your damage and totals. Incendiary Ammunition now adds its burn damage
Homecoming and Brainstorm: Fulcrum Shift now lets you set how many enemies you hit, up to 20 over two casts, and each one adds its damage bonus. Siphon Power's stacks now add to your damage too
Homecoming and Brainstorm: Personal Force Field now gives its always-on bonus to defense, resistance and max endurance, and its defense no longer switches off when In combat is on
Arctic Air, the phase powers and a few Rebirth and Thunderspy stealth powers no longer switch off when In combat is on.
The Info panel shows +Max End in endurance points, the same as your totals, so Personal Force Field reads +5 rather than 500%
Added a few light mode theme options.
Endurance Modification enhancements now boost endurance drain, endurance given to allies, and -Recovery
Rebirth: Boxing, Kick and Cross Punch now get their +15% damage for each other Fighting attack you've actually taken.

Brainstorm (open beta) data updated to the September 28 patch: Blinding Powder, Flash Arrow, Flash Pulse and Flash Bang now blind for 20 seconds, Tesla Coil and Vines holds stack twice, and Knockout Blow's description now says KnockUp
Homecoming: Combat Teleport's range no longer includes range bonuses from the rest of your build
Rebirth: Force Bolt shows its damage again, so damage per activation and per endurance can be worked out
Powers can be moved to a different level by dragging again

Damage procs now count toward a power's damage again, shown as "+N proc" under the damage number and as a cyan section on the damage bar. The new Procs button on the Damage heading turns this on and off. Attack Chain follows the same setting
Hovering a proc's chance on the Info tab now shows the calculation for that power.
If Sidekick is updated while you have it open, a banner now asks you to refresh, the same as in the beta. After refreshing, What's new opens so you can see what changed
Slotted damage proc shows its damage per hit and its average per cast.
When signed in, your dashboard and panel layout now save to your account and follow you to any browser or device you sign in on
New "Panels by category" button in the Dashboard settings: one click splits the stats into one panel per category, similar to Sidekick beta.
Panels that replace other panels now appear where the old ones were, instead of at the bottom of the screen
Restored DMG / DPA / DPS / DPE buttons to the infopanel
Procs slotted in a power now show on its Info tab
Hovering an enhancement in the enhancement picker now shows what it enhances, its proc info, and set bonuses

Power pool picker: taking a power just takes one click now, and pointing at it shows its details first. On touch screens, tap once to read a power and tap again to take it. The window should no longer jump around as you move between powers

Fixed a freeze where every button stopped responding after looking at certain attacks, such as The Lotus Drops and Whirling Sword. Clicks made during the freeze were still saved, so if this happened to you, check your build for duplicate powers. Sorry!
Signing in no longer replaces your account's saved layout with changes you made while signed out
Fixed a layout saved to your account failing to load
Slotted enhancements now show the same frame as in the enhancement picker
On phones, tall windows now scroll
The ⋮ button on each power now opens a menu: pin the power to the Info Panel, empty all its slots, or remove all its slots. On mobile this is the way to pin a power
On mobile, tap a set's name in the enhancement picker to see its set bonuses
Powersets were listed in the game's internal order, under their internal names. They are now alphabetical, by the display names names used in game
When some of a power's damage only happens against certain enemy ranks, the Info panel now lets you pick the rank to see it
Slot levels should now be visible.
Builds sent from [redacted] should no open in Sidekick
Game import: Inherent power should now be filed correctly, and empty unknown powers are skipped
Hovering for info should now work over available powers, and right clicking should now lock the info.
Added color themes.
